summary.en: Sudanese armed forces have carried out drone strikes on markets in the disputed Abyei border region, killing more than 150 people in each attack. The strikes hit civilian gatherings, including mourners and a fuel market, causing hundreds of casualties. Communal clashes continue, with killings reported between Warrap and Lakes communities and arrests related to youth violence in Juba. Fresh attacks in Ruweng left nine dead and six wounded, and bodies arrived from the Khor Kaltan killings in Northern Bahr el Ghazal. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den sudanske hæren har gjennomført droneangrep på markeder i den omstridte grenseområdet Abyei, og drept mer enn 150 personer i hvert angrep. Angrepene rammet sivile samlinger, inkludert sørgende og et drivstoffmarked, og forårsaket hundrevis av skadde. Kommunale sammenstøt fortsetter, med drap rapportert mellom Warrap- og Lakes-samfunnene og arrestasjoner knyttet til ungdomsvold i Juba. Nye angrep i Ruweng etterlot ni døde og seks sårede, og lik ankom fra drapene i Khor Kaltan i Nord-Bahr el Ghazal. UCDP registrerte to dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: South Sudanese Civil War
background.extract: The South Sudanese Civil War was a multi-sided civil war in South Sudan fought from 2013 to 2018 between government and opposition forces. The civil war caused rampant human rights abuses, including forced displacement, ethnic massacres, and killings of journalists by various parties. Since the war's end, South Sudan has been governed by a coalition formed by leaders of the former warring factions, Salva Kiir Mayardit and Riek Machar. The country continues to recover from the war while experiencing ongoing and systemic ethnic violence.
